name: universal-video-notes
title_zh: 1700+ 视频站一键落成带 YAML 眉批的 Ob
tagline_zh: B站、YouTube 看完就忘？它把元数据、字幕或本地语音转写、AI 摘要一次装进 Markdown。
tagline_en: Bilibili/YouTube videos vanish into structured Markdown: metadata, CC subs or local SenseVoice ASR, AI summary.
desc_en: Convert videos from Bilibili, YouTube and 1700+ supported sites to structured Obsidian Markdown documents. Extracts metadata, downloads CC subtitles or performs ASR transcription with local SenseVoice model, and generates AI-powered summaries with YAML frontmatter.
why_zh: 不是剪藏，是重构：先抽元数据，再选字幕或本地 ASR。
why_en: Not clipping—rebuilding. It extracts metadata, downloads subs or runs local ASR, then emits a frontmatter-rich note built for.
limit_zh: 只认视频页 URL，不认本地文件；AI 摘要需自备 OpenAI 兼容接口。
limit_en: URLs only, no local files. AI summary needs your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint. First ASR run downloads SenseVoice. No subs + no GPU = painfully.
title_en: Turn videos from 1700+ sites into structured Obsidian notes
